source.stem:
Multiple choice questions.

System of equations

$$
\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 3 x + 4 y = 5, \\ - 7 x + 9 y = - \frac {5}{2} \end{array} \right.
$$

The solution is ( ).

(A) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 2,\\ y = -0.25 \end{array} \right.$

(B) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -5.5,\\ y = 4 \end{array} \right.$

(C) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = 1,\\ y = 0.5 \end{array} \right.$

(D) $\left\{ \begin{array}{l}x = -1,\\ y = -0.5 \end{array} \right.$

hinge.title: Convert between units, tenths, hundredths, and thousandths as different ways to describe the same quantity.

mx.name: term_substitution
mx.teacher_note: One-hundredth is the label that belongs on this item, so 'Convert between units, tenths, hundredths, and thousandths as' is answered as one-hundredth rather than one-tenth.

mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: one-tenth still holds here even though Regroup only between adjacent decimal parts using groups of ten is missing from the stem — on the item about Convert between units, tenths, hundredths, and.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: The answer is one-tenth because of the most obvious label, colour, size or printed number in the stem, without using 'Convert between units, tenths, hundredths, and thousandths as' as the operative test.

intelligence.enrichment: Ten one-tenths make 1 unit, ten one-hundredths make 1 one-tenth, and ten one-thousandths make 1 one-hundredth; therefore a quantity can be regrouped between larger and smaller place-value parts without changing its value.
